items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Then I remember a woman over there called Big Mary, was the blues singer on the Rabbit Foot Show.

ctx.x: Yeah, but she's not the original Ma Rainey. She just calls herself Ma Rainey. Well, I remember her singing over there. She was the blues singer there a little while. Then I remember a woman over there called Big Mary, was the blues singer on the Rabbit Foot Show. Big Mary, that's all I know about her. Big Mary. I see a Mizzou, no, that's it.
Somebody with a name similar to that made some records in Chicago about five or six years ago.
